title: Puig CEO wants the company to become a ‘global dermocosmetics champion’
summary: Puig CEO Jose Manuel Albesa spoke on the importance of the beauty company carving its place in the dermocosmetics category, bolstering its offering by taking full ownership of Isdin next year and planning to double the sales of Uriage by 2032
